label: Fraud chargebacks on one seller
explain: Reason code 10.4 is 'fraud: card absent'. Ten or more on a single seller in a week is not noise.

label: Cardholders say 'not me'
explain: Support tickets from cardholders who did not place the order. On their own they look like stolen accounts.

jev.question: Does this ticket say the person did not make the purchase themselves?

criteria.true: The reporter denies placing the order or says their card or account was used without permission.
criteria.false: A shipping, quality, payout or account-help question, or a seller complaint.

label: One device, many buyers
explain: Eight or more buyer accounts logging in from the same device fingerprint. Real households share a device between two or three people, not eight.

label: WELCOME25 concentrated on one seller
explain: A new-customer promo is meant to spread across the catalogue. Twenty-five or more uses on one seller means somebody is steering it.

label: Flagged card BINs approved
explain: A card BIN the partner flags for card testing, and approved authorizations on that same BIN. Neither source alone says this.

label: Day-old accounts buying big
explain: Accounts under two days old placing orders over 150, twenty or more of them on the same seller.

label: Risk rules v7 deployed
explain: A change ticket: the risk model's rules were tightened on the 7th. Anything that moved after that could be the model.

label: Two sellers, one payout account
explain: Two registered sellers paying out to the same bank account are one business wearing two names.

label: Declines up under v7
explain: Twenty-five or more declines attributed to the new rules. It explains unhappy customers; it does not explain chargebacks, which only follow approvals.
